title: Fix Scholar Gold logo mismatch by regenerating icons from the latest uploaded reference and updating all frontend references

requirements.text: Regenerate the Scholar Gold logo/app-icon/favicons so they visually match the latest user-uploaded reference image `Screenshot_2026_0210_153957-1.jpg` (ornate gold circular border + deep navy radial background + central gold book icon + “SCHOLAR GOLD” text + “made by PD” subtitle), exporting PNG assets in standard icon sizes and using fresh cache-safe filenames.

quotes: Logo is not same I said

acceptanceCriteria: New PNG icon assets are generated from `Screenshot_2026_0210_153957-1.jpg` and are visually consistent with the uploaded reference (ornate gold ring, navy radial background, book icon, correct title/subtitle).
Generated icon assets use NEW filenames (not the existing `*-v3.*` filenames) to avoid browser caching issues.
At minimum, the generated set includes 512x512, 192x192, and 32x32 PNGs.

requirements.text: Update all frontend references to use the newly generated cache-safe Scholar Gold icon filenames for: (1) browser favicon and app icons in `frontend/index.html`, and (2) the brand logo image rendered in `frontend/src/components/Header.tsx` and `frontend/src/components/LoginScreen.tsx`, ensuring the displayed logo matches the latest reference image after a normal reload (no manual cache clearing).

quotes: Logo is not same I said

acceptanceCriteria: `frontend/index.html` no longer references `/assets/generated/scholar-gold-*-v3.*` and instead references the newly generated cache-safe icon filenames for 32x32, 192x192, and 512x512.

`frontend/src/components/Header.tsx` and `frontend/src/components/LoginScreen.tsx` no longer reference `/assets/generated/scholar-gold-app-icon-v3.dim_512x512.png` and instead reference the newly generated 512x512 icon filename.
After a hard refresh is NOT required: a normal reload shows the updated icon in the browser tab favicon and in both the authenticated header and login header brand mark.

constraints: Do not modify any files under frontend immutable paths (e.g., `frontend/src/main.tsx`, `frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts`, `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts(x)`, and `frontend/src/components/ui/*`).
Store generated icon assets as static files under `frontend/public/assets/generated` and reference them directly (do not serve generated images from the backend).
Use English for any user-facing text.
nonGoals: Do not change the app name text (it should remain “Scholar Gold”).
Do not introduce new UI features unrelated to the logo/icon mismatch.
Do not change backend logic or schemas for this request.
